title: 039 NNPredict -- follow-ups 2 sizer: the excursion-H32 Ridge's predicted move as a width-book sizer (cs_aro pattern), same screen and rule as preregistration_sizer.json
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; it selects the model the framework and sizer stages use.
model: nnp_ridge_exc32_op (explicit; not the framework stage's selection)
screen: research/nnpredict/screen.py --model NNP_RIDGE_EXC32 --prereg sizer_exc32 --out screen_exc32.json, on the 412 early width-book trades; both directions; no training, no backtest, late half blind
screen_decision: pass if either direction passes; the passing direction (the larger gap_share50 if both) is the sizer's score sign
sizer_threshold: per fold, research/nnpredict/pick.py --model nnp_ridge_exc32_op --out sizer_thresholds_exc32.json (0.5 agree share at width-book run starts on the training validation tail); the flip direction, if it is the passing one, negates the score before the pick
alone: judge_one(sizer_arm, sizer_control) must PASS; judge_one vs w_aro and cs_aro reported
seed_rule: a PASS with whole-period gain < 1 pp needs a seed-2 rerun before any adoption
fallback: screen fails in both directions -> no sizer backtest; recorded as the stage result
seen_before: the LSTM screen (screen.json): fails both directions, gap 0.028
